name: Aislynn Thomas-McDonald
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Coral Gables, Florida
education: Florida International University College of Law
about: Aislynn Thomas-McDonald is an attorney at Thomas-McDonald Law in Miami, Florida. Ms. McDonald devotes her practice to family law, estate planning and probate, serving clients throughout Miami. She handles matters involving divorce, adoption, child custody, marital agreements, guardianships, probate administration, trusts and wills.
Ms. McDonald is experienced with litigation and collaborative law methods, including mediation. Recognized for her accomplishments, she is AV Preeminent* peer review rated by Martindale-Hubbell.

Active in both her legal and professional communities, Ms. McDonald is a member of the Dade County Bar Association, the Duval County Bar Association, the Monroe County Bar Association, The Florida Bar and the Florida Association for Women Lawyers, Inc. She is a former professor in the English departments of Belhaven University and Miami Dade College.

Ms. McDonald enjoys giving back to her community through volunteer work. She volunteers her time to organizations, including The Bolles School parent association, the Chapman Partnership for the homeless, the Fund for American Studies and ProLiteracy. She is a former board member of the Baptist Health Foundation, South Florida, the Growing Place Early Childhood Center and the Women’s Committee for Big Brothers Big Sisters of Miami.

Ms. McDonald obtained a bachelor’s degree from the American University of Paris and earned a master’s degree from Mississippi College. She received her law degree from Florida International University College of Law. Prior to her legal career, she spent many years teaching and advocating for various causes, including children’s legal advocacy, domestic violence awareness, the literary arts and the rights of women.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
